title: Amazon EventBridge to Amazon CloudWatch Logs
description: Create an EventBridge rule that sends events to CloudWatch Logs

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This template creates an EventBridge event bus and rule that publishes matched events to CloudWatch Logs. In this example, the rule filters for specific attributes in the event before sending to the CloudWatch Logs target.

bullets.text: Reducing custom code by using advanced rules in Amazon EventBridge
Use Amazon EventBridge to Build Decoupled, Event-Driven Architectures

testing.headline: Testing
text: Use the AWS CLI to send a test event to EventBridge and observe the event delivered to the Lambda function:
1. Send an event to EventBridge: aws events put-events --entries file://event.json.
2. The event appears in the CloudWatch Logs stream called /aws/events/resource-policy-test.
